requests: Demonstrate that the eligibility engine was tested before this release, and show the result.
ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3
Show that the test suite relied upon is capable of detecting faults, not merely of executing the code.
EU AI Act Art. 17
Produce the static security analysis performed on the code in this release.
CRA Annex I Part I; NIST SSDF PW.7
For each security finding raised, show the disposition and the reasoning recorded for it.
CRA Art. 13(8)
List the third-party components in this release and show they carried no known vulnerability at build time.
CRA Annex II; NIST SSDF PS.3
Show which parts of this release were machine-generated and how that was recorded at the time.
EU AI Act Art. 12; NIST SSDF PS.3.2
Demonstrate that the AI component was tested against adversarial input before release.
EU AI Act Art. 15; NIST AI 600-1
Show the release decision, who or what made it, and on what evidence.
EU AI Act Art. 43; CRA Art. 13
Trace a named requirement to the test that verifies it and to that test's result in this release.
EU AI Act Annex IV(2)(g)
Demonstrate that the retained records for this release have not been altered since they were made.
CRA Art. 13(12)
